game.title: Carrom
game.description: "Carrom is a popular South Asian tabletop flick-and-pocket game, often called "finger billiards," played on a square wooden board. Players use a heavier striker disc to knock lighter carrom men (coins) into four corner pockets, aiming to sink all their assigned pieces (white or black) and the red queen before their opponent."
howToPlay: Step 1: Set the board on a flat stand and sprinkle powder for smooth sliding.
Step 2: Arrange coins in the center with the red Queen in the middle.
Step 3: Sit opposite your opponent; the person with white coins breaks first.
Step 4: Place the striker on your baseline, touching both parallel lines.
Step 5: Flick the striker using one finger to hit your colored coins into pockets.
Step 6: Keep your turn as long as you continue to pocket your own coins.
Step 7: Pocket the Queen only after you have pocketed at least one of your coins.
Step 8: Cover the Queen by pocketing one of your own coins immediately after hitting her in.
Step 9: Pay a penalty by returning one coin to the center if you pocket the striker.
Step 10: Win the round by being the first to pocket all your coins and the Queen.
